messages:
maya: Heads up — PR #1821 is red on CI, looks like multiple snapshot/golden tests failed on the render step. buildkite: https://bk.example.com/builds/6821 — can someone triage quickly?
ci-bot: Job failed: unit-tests (agent: ubuntu-22, suite: tests/golden) — 7 failed, 2 flaky. See artifacts for diffs.
jason: which tests are failing? paste failing test names pls
maya: failing ones are: tests/test_prompt_render.py::TestPrompt::test_serialization_golden, tests/test_prompt_render.py::TestPrompt::test_multiline_prompt_golden, tests/test_snapshot_kvcache.py::test_prefix_hash_snapshot
maya: artifact link with unified diff: https://bk.example.com/artifacts/6821/golden-diffs/unified.patch
maya: snippet from the diff: ```
-  "prompt": "She said \"Hello\" and left."
+  "prompt": "She said \u201cHello\u201d and left."
```
oliver: looks like unicode quote normalization changed (straight -> curly). could be a serialization change in tokenizer/render pipeline.
sophia: might be due to the recent json encoder tweak (stable-key ordering) we merged in infra last week. ordering probs not the quote though.
luis: can we reproduce locally quickly? maya, can you paste the exact pytest command you used in CI?
maya: CI runs: `pytest tests/test_prompt_render.py::TestPrompt::test_serialization_golden -q -k golden --snapshot-update=auto` but for triage i usually run without update.
ojason: suggestion: run a smoke rerun in the same agent image before bisecting. I can kick a rerun on that buildkite job (same commit).
jason: triggered rerun for build 6821 (rebuild #2). pinging here. :rocket:
ci-bot: Rerun started: build 6821 #2 — logs: https://bk.example.com/builds/6821/attempts/2
jason: OK rerun finished — 6 passed, 1 flaky still failing (test_serialization_golden)
maya: reproducible locally for me when I run with python 3.11 and env `REDWOOD_SERIALIZE_QUOTES=curly` set. not sure why CI is switching, need to confirm default.
oliver: quick local repro command I use:```bash
# run single test with verbose and no snapshot updates
REDWOOD_SERIALIZE_QUOTES=curly python -m pytest tests/test_prompt_render.py::TestPrompt::test_serialization_golden -q -k golden
```
oliver: to try a stable-serialization fallback:```bash
# run with stable key ordering and legacy quote handling
REDWOOD_SERIALIZE_QUOTES=straight REDWOOD_SERIALIZE_ORDER=stable python -m pytest tests/test_prompt_render.py::TestPrompt::test_serialization_golden -q
```
sophia: if rerun passes sometimes it's flaky due to nondeterministic quoting from model pipeline. can we run the test 20x locally? `pytest -k serialization_golden --count=20` (requires pytest-repeat)
luis: if it's consistently failing on CI but not locally, we may need a bisect between the infra change and the encoder tweak. maya — can you share the commit range for that agent?
maya: good call — the infra change landed in commit a1b2c3 (2026-01-08) and the encoder tweak is d4e5f6 (2026-02-02). both touched serialize.py
jason: I'll bisect quickly on buildkite using the commit list and run the golden tests only. will report back in this thread.
jason: quick note for folks: to regenerate snapshots intentionally, use our snapshot tool: `pytest --snapshot-update --snapshot-backup` — but DON'T do it until we confirm the change is intended.
maya: update: jason's bisect narrowed it down to encoder tweak d4e5f6. when run with legacy env var the test passes.
sophia: good find. next steps: create small PR to either make the encoder deterministic or pin serialization env var in CI until we migrate.
luis: agree. who wants to own the fix/PR?
maya: I can open the PR to set `REDWOOD_SERIALIZE_QUOTES=straight` in the CI job and add a follow-up to properly handle curly quotes in serialization with a test. will also add an eval to catch this regressing.
jason: sounds good. assign maya and add me as reviewer. i'll approve fast if CI green. :thumbsup:
maya: thanks — I'm on it, will update this thread with PR link and a short regression test.
ci-bot: Note: build 6821 #2 artifacts archived (golden diffs)
maya: follow-up: PR opened https://git.example.com/redwood/inference/pull/1834 — sets CI env and adds regression test. marking this thread resolved for now.
